name: Ronald Reagan
role: President of the United States from 1981 to 1989
contribution: An American politician and actor who served as the 40th president of the United States from 1981 to 1989.
legacy: His tenure constituted a realignment toward conservative policies in the United States, and he is often considered an icon of American conservatism.

checks.lead: Ronald Wilson Reagan (February 6, 1911 – June 5, 2004) was an American politician and actor who served as the 40th president of the United States from 1981 to 1989. A member of the Republican Party, he became an important figure in the American conservative movement. The period encompassing his presidency is known as the Reagan era.
